scope: All nine published webapp pack JSON files, including both legacy Standard revisions; no recipe fields removed. Data assets retained separately from GPL processing code.

recipe.name: Velvia
recipe.notes: Saturated landscape slide film: deep skies, dense greens, crushed shadows. Split: magenta-leaning shade.

recipe.name: Astia
recipe.notes: Soft slide film: gentle contrast, clean skin, slightly richer skies.

recipe.name: Cl. Chrome
recipe.notes: Documentary look: muted greens and yellows, cyan skies, hard shadows.

recipe.name: Classic Neg
recipe.notes: Superia-style negative: teal-green cast, punchy mids, light skies; cyan-green shadows, magenta highlights.

recipe.name: Provia 400
recipe.notes: Fujichrome Provia 400X slide: magenta-red cast, lavender skies, rich blues, deep reds, dark greens, fast fall to black, fine grain. Advice: contrast +1.

recipe.name: Reala Ace
recipe.notes: Accurate, crisp modern negative: true hues, restrained greens.

recipe.name: Eterna
recipe.notes: Cinema negative: flat, open shadows, quiet teal-leaning colour. Split: cyan shadows, warm highlights.

recipe.name: Bleach Byp.
recipe.notes: Silver-retained cinema look: near-monochrome, harsh contrast. Split: steely blue-cyan shadows.

recipe.name: Kodachrome64
recipe.notes: Rich deep reds, golden yellows, dense cyan-blue skies, olive greens. Split: warm highlights, slightly cool shadows.

recipe.name: Portra 400
recipe.notes: Warm pastel portrait negative: glowing skin, soft contrast. Split: peachy highlights.

recipe.name: Ektar 100
recipe.notes: Ultra-vivid fine-grain negative: saturated reds and blues. Split: warm highlights, blue deep shadows.

recipe.name: Gold 200
recipe.notes: Golden consumer negative: sunny yellows, muted cyan skies. Split: yellow-tinted whites.

recipe.name: Ektachrome
recipe.notes: Clean, cool slide film: neutral skin, bright saturated blues. Split: blue shade.

recipe.name: CineStill800
recipe.notes: Tungsten cinema film: cool cast, red bloom (bloom_tint red: the glow's Cr spreads far more than its luma, docs/HALATION_RED.md section 8) plus red/orange light. Split: cyan shadows, warm highlights.

recipe.name: Pro 400H
recipe.notes: Airy pastel negative: minty greens, light cyan skies. Split: green-cyan shade.

recipe.name: Faux IR
recipe.notes: Infrared-inspired false colour (golden/orange foliage, deep blue skies). Not true Aerochrome: the hue range can't turn green red. Sat advice: strong (+3..+5). Split: blue shadows, orange highlights.

recipe.name: Kodachrome25
recipe.notes: Kodachrome 25 slide (GarethB, mu-43): dense, rich reds, muted cyan/green, deep shadows. Advice: contrast +2, H-2 M+3 S-5. Split: slightly cool deep shadows.

recipe.name: Portra 160
recipe.notes: Fine-grain portrait negative (I. Mitropoulos, om-recipes): natural skin, quiet greens, soft contrast.

recipe.name: Fujicolor200
recipe.notes: Fujicolor C200 (J. Bloomer, om-recipes): warm yellows, fresh greens, soft contrast. Split: green-yellow shadows.

recipe.name: Cuban Neg
recipe.notes: Inspired by Osan's Classic Cuban Neg: warm Classic Neg, golden cast (WB A+4), deep blues/reds, gritty grain, bloom 3. Sat: +2 warm, -2 greens. Split: golden highlights.

recipe.name: Cibachrome
recipe.notes: Cibachrome print (Jay, om-recipes): glossy magenta-reds, deep blues, rich darks. Split: cool deep shadows.

recipe.name: UltraMax 400
recipe.notes: Kodak consumer negative: warm, punchy reds/yellows, olive greens, visible grain. Split: yellow highlights, blue-violet shadows.

recipe.name: Agfa Vista
recipe.notes: Agfa Vista 200: vivid magenta-leaning reds, deep blues, cool cheap-film punch. Split: red highlights.

recipe.name: CineStill50D
recipe.notes: Daylight cinema stock: clean, slightly cool, rich blues, soft highlights, faint red glow.

recipe.name: Vision3 250D
recipe.notes: Kodak daylight cinema negative: flat, wide latitude, gentle teal/orange separation. Split: cyan shadows, warm highlights.

recipe.name: Vision3 500T
recipe.notes: Tungsten cinema negative in daylight: cool teal cast, warm lights, open shadows. Split: cyan shadows, warm highlights.

recipe.name: Polaroid
recipe.notes: Integral instant film: punchy, narrow dynamic range (bright highlights, deep shadows), pink highlights, green shadows.

recipe.name: Cross Proc.
recipe.notes: E-6 slide in C-41: hard contrast, yellow-green highlights, cyan skies, yellowed skin.

recipe.name: Atrophy
recipe.notes: Inspired by GxAce's Atrophy: urban-decay grade, near-grey base, muted greens/skies, rust and reds kept, gritty clarity. Sat advice: greens/blues -4..-5. Split: teal-grey shadows, rusty highlights.

recipe.name: Acros
recipe.notes: Fine-grain mono: deep blacks, smooth tones, darker reds.

recipe.name: Tri-X 400
recipe.notes: Classic gritty reportage mono: punchy contrast, darker skies.

recipe.name: HP5 Plus
recipe.notes: Soft, grainy mono with wide latitude and open shadows.

recipe.name: C200 Airy
recipe.notes: Fujicolor C200 rated a stop over: bright mids, lighter skies, warm yellows, fresh greens, soft contrast. Split: green-yellow shadows.

recipe.name: Superia 400
recipe.notes: Fuji Superia 400 in daylight: teal-leaning greens, cyan-green shade, a magenta lift in the highlights, punchy mids.

recipe.name: 400H Overex
recipe.notes: Pro 400H overexposed 1-2 stops: the airy pastel look. Milky lifted blacks, soft unclipped highlights, minty greens. Split: green-cyan shade.

recipe.name: Pro 160NS
recipe.notes: Fuji Pro 160NS: neutral grey balance, restrained colour, slightly pink skin and a faint purple lean, good greens, soft contrast.

recipe.name: Acros
recipe.notes: Fine-grain mono: deep blacks, smooth tones, darker reds.

recipe.name: 800T Neon
recipe.notes: CineStill 800T under neon: tungsten-balanced, teal shade, red halation round signs and lamps, richer magentas and blues. Split: cyan shadows, warm highlights.

recipe.name: Natura 1600
recipe.notes: Fuji Natura 1600, the Japan-only night film: natural, slightly muted colour, soft contrast, blacks not quite deep. Split: night skies drift blue.

recipe.name: Portra 800
recipe.notes: Portra 800 under street lamps: warm natural skin, colour that holds up in low light, soft contrast, plain glow (antihalation layer: no red halo). Split: warm highlights.

recipe.name: Superia Nite
recipe.notes: Fuji Superia shot at night: underexposed shade goes green, highlights lean magenta, teal-leaning greens. Split: green shadows, magenta highlights.

recipe.name: 400H Night
recipe.notes: Pro 400H after dark: its fourth colour layer keeps fluorescent light clean; cool pastel colour, minty greens, a little more blue for signage. Split: green-cyan shade.

recipe.name: Tri-X Push
recipe.notes: Tri-X pushed to EI 1600: hard contrast, blocked shadows, burnt-in greys, the grainy Shinjuku-at-night street style. Advice: contrast +2, shadows -4.

recipe.name: Ektar 100
recipe.notes: Ultra-vivid fine-grain negative: saturated reds and blues. Split: warm highlights, blue deep shadows.

recipe.name: Velvia Lite
recipe.notes: Velvia toned down for people in summer light: rich skies and greens without the crushed shadows or blown saturation. Split: magenta-leaning shade.

recipe.name: UltraMax 400
recipe.notes: Kodak consumer negative: warm, punchy reds/yellows, olive greens, visible grain. Split: yellow highlights, blue-violet shadows.

recipe.name: X-Pro Sunny
recipe.notes: Gentler cross-processing (E-6 in C-41): high contrast, yellow-green highlights, cyan skies, warm skin, less extreme than Cross Proc. Split: yellow-green highlights.

recipe.name: Sun Bleach
recipe.notes: Negative overexposed in hard sun: bleached pastels, lifted shadows, soft rolled-off whites, pale skies, warm cast. Split: yellow highlights.

recipe.name: Gold 200
recipe.notes: Golden consumer negative: sunny yellows, muted cyan skies. Split: yellow-tinted whites.

recipe.name: Portra 400
recipe.notes: Warm pastel portrait negative: glowing skin, soft contrast. Split: peachy highlights.

recipe.name: Ektar Autumn
recipe.notes: Ektar 100 for foliage: saturated reds and oranges, yellow-green leaves pushed golden, deep blue skies. Split: warm highlights, blue deep shadows.

recipe.name: ColorPlus200
recipe.notes: Kodak ColorPlus 200: warm, a little less yellow than Gold, moderate saturation, budget-film softness; shade drifts blue-purple. Split: violet shadows.

recipe.name: Faded Amber
recipe.notes: Faded warm print (a grade, not a stock): lifted blacks, low saturation, weak blues and greens, amber whites. Split: orange highlights.

recipe.name: Portra Cool
recipe.notes: Portra 160 in snow and overcast light: natural skin, quiet colour, one WB step cooler for winter shade (a grading choice). Split: blue-cyan shade.

recipe.name: Pro 400H
recipe.notes: Airy pastel negative: minty greens, light cyan skies. Split: green-cyan shade.

recipe.name: E100 Snow
recipe.notes: Ektachrome E100 for snow: clean neutral whites with highlights held, blue shade, crisp but slightly calmer blues than Ektachrome. Split: blue shade.

recipe.name: Eterna
recipe.notes: Cinema negative: flat, open shadows, quiet teal-leaning colour. Split: cyan shadows, warm highlights.

recipe.notes: Fine-grain mono: deep blacks, smooth tones, darker reds.
